away.name: Jacob Fowler
away.news: Fowler will start in New York on Monday.

home.name: Joonas Korpisalo
home.news: Korpisalo has seen limited action since making his debut earlier this month, returning from a lower-body injury, but has been solid when called upon. The 32-year-old Finnish goalie was excellent in his most recent outing, saving 29 of 30 shots (.967 SV%) in a 3-1 win over the Calgary Flames. The Rangers enter Monday's game as slight -101 home underdogs against a Montreal Canadiens team coming off a 4-1 loss to the Colorado Avalanche.
